title: Haye Haye ye safar Zainab ka
body:
Haye Haye ye safar Zainab ka
Haey haey yeh safar zainbab(s.a.) Ka
haey haey yeh safar zainbab(s.a.) Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Na mehmil hai na chadar aur sham ka yeh bazaray haey kis ko sada day zainab(s.a.) Sajjad(a.s.) Mera beemaaray
Naa paak nigaho'n say gar mujh ko bachana hai
qur'aan meray bhai(a.s.) Naizay peh sunana hai
kis tarha chhupaaey khud ko
is waqt behan laachaaray
<<MINI>>
Haey kis ko sada day
zainab(s.a.) Sajjad(a.s.) Mera beemaaray
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo wa'ada kiya tujh say poora usay karna hai
in shaam ki galiyo'n say bay pardah guzarna hai
chadar ka muhafiz jo tha
is baat peh maatam daar ay
<<MINI>>
Haey kis ko sada day
zainab(s.a.) Sajjad(a.s.) Mera beemaar ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis darjah museebat hai kis darjah pareshani
barsaey koi pathhar, koi phainkay garm paani
koi sadqah hum par phainkay, koi jaltay huway angaaray
<<MINI>>
Haey kis ko sada day
zainab(s.a.) Sajjad(a.s.) Mera beemaar ay

Yeh aalam-e-majboori bas roti rahi zainab(s.a)
ghazi(a.s.) Ki behan hokar kuch kar na saki zainab(s.a)
zalim nay teri bachhi ko kai baar tama'nchay maaray
<<MINI>>

ghash khaa kay jo girjae'n
durro'n say jagatay hain
chhalay bhi yehi kehtay hain aur zakhm jigar kay saaray

bas itni duaa day bhai is waqt na himmat haaray

jo us ko aziyyat hai zanjeer batati hai
